answer: Mechanism: Tempo-Orchard gating. Each agent must emit requests on a per-epoch timing profile derived from public randomness plus local telemetry (timber-load cycles, copper-link latency, orchard sensor cadence). Validators score inter-arrival entropy, burstiness, and cross-account timing correlation; clones sharing a profile are throttled. An attacker must generate distinct, sustained traffic shapes and keep them synchronized to freshness windows, multiplying coordination, bandwidth, and monitoring cost per sybil.
